records.placeText: Scope and Contents This document is really several stapled together. There are multiple wine lists, and two letters to customers. Apparently, "this is probably the most outstanding achievement in the history of 'America's Largest Liquor Store.'" The next letter, from 1942, describes its liquor as "safe from the ruthless hands of the invaders."
